stem.text: What explains how the maximum uptake of oxygen occurs as blood passes through the capillaries of the lungs?

A.text: Each haemoglobin molecule can temporarily bind to four oxygen atoms.

B.text: Oxyhaemoglobin formation increases the capacity of red blood cells to transport oxygen.

C.text: The binding of the first oxygen molecule to haemoglobin decreases the molecule’s affinity for binding other oxygen molecules.

D.text: The dissociation of carbon dioxide from carboxyhaemoglobin allows more haemoglobin to be available for oxygen binding.
